instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
prompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious decorative envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying a strong central presence in the frame. The envelope is inspired by a circus theme, handcrafted and premium, with realistic paper texture, soft matte finish, subtle fibers, elegant folds and precise geometry. The design uses a romantic pink color palette in multiple tones of rose, blush, coral pink and soft magenta, with delicate pearlescent or metallic accents in gold or champagne. The envelope includes refined circus-inspired ornamental details such as a wax seal, ribbon, embossed carnival motifs, tiny star patterns, elegant stripes, mini flags, subtle marquee-style flourishes and tactile decorative closure, all finely detailed and luxurious.

The envelope is placed within a rich, story-driven circus environment, not a flat backdrop. The background forms a magical nighttime circus scene — such as a grand vintage circus tent interior, a dreamy carnival entrance, or a whimsical fairground lit by lanterns — softly blurred but visually recognizable. Circus architecture, striped fabric, glowing lights, bunting, ferris wheel silhouettes, and festive decorative elements create depth and context while keeping the envelope as the clear hero. Surrounding elements are carefully curated and symbolic, including floating confetti, pink petals, sparkles, glowing dust, feathers and light particles, arranged organically around the envelope. These elements feel natural, floating gently, enhancing motion and wonder without overpowering the composition.

Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with soft key light illuminating the envelope, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and volumetric light rays streaming from above or behind. Subtle mist, atmospheric haze and floating particles catch the light, creating a dreamy, magical and premium mood. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional. The color palette is intentional and harmonious, dominated by romantic pink tones with warm highlights, soft gold reflections and gentle luminous gradients, inspired by luxury invitations and editorial photography.

Composition: foreground-focused, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on envelope texture, seal and ornaments, cinematic bokeh in background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, magical, premium invitation aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for premium invitations, celebrations and storytelling visuals.

folhaPrompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a large blank decorative sheet of paper as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying almost the entire frame, while still leaving visible space around the edges to reveal the ground, background and side elements. The sheet feels premium, handcrafted and refined, with realistic paper texture, soft matte finish, subtle fibers, elegant clean edges and a pristine empty center designed for custom content. Ornamental details frame the paper delicately, with circus-inspired adornments arranged around it: elegant ribbons, tiny stars, confetti, balloons, carnival tassels, theatrical trims, delicate lace, ornamental curls, and playful luxury accents, all carefully balanced so the blank sheet remains the clear hero of the composition. The environment is a rich circus scene, not a flat backdrop — a magical pink circus tent interior or an enchanted carnival stage with soft visible floor, side curtains, decorative posts, and subtle background props, softly blurred but still recognizable. The composition includes depth and storytelling, with side elements such as circus lights, velvet drapes, ringmaster-inspired details, balloons, and festive decorations placed organically around the sheet, enhancing the theme without overpowering the central empty space. Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with a soft key light illuminating the paper, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and warm volumetric glow from circus lamps or stage lights. Subtle atmospheric haze, floating dust particles and gentle sparkles catch the light, creating a dreamy, festive and premium mood. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional, grounding the sheet naturally on the visible floor. The color palette is entirely inspired by pink tones, with harmonious shades of blush pink, rose, magenta, pastel pink, dusty pink and soft gold accents, creating an elegant circus fantasy atmosphere with smooth gradients, luminous highlights and controlled contrast. Composition: foreground-focused, blank sheet sharply in focus, ornaments framing the paper, visible floor and side elements, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper texture and decorative details, cinematic bokeh in background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, magical, premium circus invitation aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for premium circus invitations and storytelling visuals.
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão na horizontal elegante nessa mesma atmosfera e mesmo tema (Circo) e mesma paleta de cor (Tons de Rosa), escrito apenas Isis, idade 15 Anos.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
aberturaSlide2Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
